## Download

**Easiest:** use the download page at https://shubhams-work.github.io/IEEE-conference-/. It picks the right file for your computer.

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | `IEEE-Paper-Checker-Setup-….exe` |
| macOS · Apple silicon (M1–M4) | `IEEE-Paper-Checker-…-macOS-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS · Intel | `IEEE-Paper-Checker-…-macOS-x86_64.dmg` |
| Ubuntu / Debian / Mint | `ieee-paper-checker_…_amd64.deb` |
| Other Linux | `IEEE-Paper-Checker-…-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

Each installer includes everything it needs, so you don't need Python. The app is not signed by Microsoft or Apple:

- **Windows:** if "Windows protected your PC" appears, click *More info → Run anyway*.
- **macOS:** open the app once, then *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*.

Every installer here was built, installed and tested automatically on Windows, macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) and Linux.
